usage_note: These are official landing pages or filing portals for source discovery. The public demo does not mirror full reports. The demo metric values are illustrative until each fact is linked to a verified filing passage.

sources.title: NVIDIA Investor Relations
sources.notes: Cloudflare or rate limits may affect automated requests; use browser/manual review or SEC filing links when needed.

sources.title: NVIDIA SEC filings
sources.notes: Use accession number and filing page as the citation anchor; respect SEC fair-access rules.

sources.title: SMIC Investor Relations
sources.notes: HKEX English materials are a useful first pass; compare with SSE Chinese filings when accounting scope matters.

sources.title: Microsoft Investor Relations
sources.notes: Microsoft fiscal year ends June 30; distinguish reported growth from constant-currency growth.

sources.title: Microsoft SEC filings
sources.notes: Azure absolute revenue may not always be disclosed; do not infer it from a relative growth statement.

sources.title: Alibaba Investor Relations
sources.notes: Fiscal year ends March 31; segment definitions changed during restructuring, so historical comparisons need a comparability note.

sources.title: Alibaba SEC filings
sources.notes: Use the issuer's 20-F for consolidated definitions and risk disclosures; preserve reporting currency and accounting basis.

sources.title: Baidu Investor Relations
sources.notes: The official page provides press releases, financial reports, SEC filings and HKEX filing links; verify each announcement date.

sources.title: Baidu SEC filings
sources.notes: Watch consolidated/affiliate presentation and non-GAAP reconciliations.

sources.title: Amazon Investor Relations
sources.notes: Amazon reports AWS, retail and advertising in one filing set; segment margin is not fully symmetric across businesses.

sources.title: Amazon SEC filings
sources.notes: Advertising became a separately disclosed revenue line in recent reporting periods; keep the first comparable period explicit.

sources.title: Alphabet Investor Relations
sources.notes: Google Services, Google Cloud and Other Bets are separate reporting units; segment history may change.

sources.title: Alphabet SEC filings
sources.notes: Read advertising and cloud notes together; do not turn a disclosed growth rate into an absolute number without a source.

sources.title: Meta Investor Relations
sources.notes: Family metrics and advertising metrics have distinct definitions; preserve the exact scope of each metric.

sources.title: Meta SEC filings
sources.notes: Separate GAAP figures, non-GAAP management metrics and Reality Labs disclosures.

sources.title: Tencent Investor Relations
sources.notes: Use HKEX filings and official results releases; distinguish IFRS from non-IFRS management metrics.
